common.tagline: File your Right to Information request in minutes
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.heroDescription: The Right to Information Act gives every Indian citizen the right to ask the government for information. We make it simple.
landing.step1Desc: Tell us what happened in plain language. No legal knowledge needed.
landing.step2Desc: Our tool turns your complaint into a specific, legally sound RTI request.
landing.step3Desc: We route your request to the correct government office — Central or State.
landing.step4Desc: The government must respond within 30 days. We help you track it.
landing.painPoint1Desc: We route it correctly — Central or State.
landing.painPoint2Desc: We score it and draft your first appeal.
landing.painPoint3Desc: Describe your problem — we write the request.
landing.faq1A: The Right to Information Act 2005 gives every Indian citizen the legal right to request information from any government body. The government must respond within 30 days.
landing.faq2A: ₹10 for most states. Some states charge ₹50. BPL (Below Poverty Line) cardholders file for free.
landing.faq3Q: What if the government doesn't reply?
landing.faq3A: If there's no reply within 30 days, you can file a First Appeal. If that fails, you can escalate to the Information Commission.
landing.faq4A: RTI applications must include your name and address, but the purpose need not be disclosed. Your identity is protected by law.

file.step1Desc: Describe the issue in your own words. No legal language needed.
file.step1Placeholder: For example: I applied for a ration card 6 months ago and haven't heard anything. I want to know the status of my application.
file.step1Hint: Be specific: what happened, when, and which office was involved.
file.step2Desc: We need this to route your request to the correct authority.
file.step3Desc: This is your sharpened RTI request. Copy it or download it.

track.emptyDesc: File your first RTI request to start tracking it here.
track.pageDesc: Monitor the status and 30-day deadlines of your RTI requests.

checkReply.step1Desc: Copy the text of the reply from the government and paste it below.
checkReply.strongDesc: The reply addresses your request. No further action needed.
checkReply.weakDesc: The reply does not fully answer your question. You have the right to file a First Appeal.

appeal.desc: This appeal cites the exact gap between what you asked and what the government replied.
appeal.note: File this appeal to the First Appellate Authority (FAA) of the same department. The FAA must respond within 30 days.

about.introDesc: Under the RTI Act, every Indian citizen has the right to ask any government body for information. The government must respond within 30 days.
about.whoCanFileDesc: Any Indian citizen. You do not need a reason.
about.whatCanAskDesc: Any information held by a public authority — documents, files, emails, meeting minutes, spending records, decisions.
about.howLongDesc: 30 days for a reply. 48 hours if the matter relates to life or liberty.
about.whatIfNoDesc: File a First Appeal within 30 days of the deadline. If that fails, escalate to the State or Central Information Commission.
about.rightsSummaryDesc: You can ask any government body for any document, and they must give it to you — or give you a lawful reason why not.
